ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between a dominant high-intensity (white/light-grey) central surface area and low-intensity (black) peripheral margins and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Light intensity pixels cover approximately 85% of the visible ventral surface; distinct low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous jagged border along the trailing edge and defines approximately 12 discrete circular focal spots distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a depth approximately 15% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular saw-tooth serrations along the entire 2D linear boundary between the fluke and water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curvature of the trailing edges transitioning to a sharp upward curve at the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular and annular dark pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed bilaterally across the light-colored ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Cluster of 4-5 parallel dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) localized on the distal portion of the right lobe, oriented toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (barnacle attachment marks) across both lobes and linear rake marks on the right lobe surface.
